description: Daily narrative with no capacity table. Beds and occupancy are not reported at province level; isolation sites are named in prose only.

TABLEAU "Indicateur" by province: beds, patients at bed (J-1), admissions and exits in 24 h, patients in isolation with a confirmed/suspect split, and from SitRep 060 an occupancy rate row. Columns gain and lose provinces through the era.

Two-column dashboard layout. The figures are present in prose but the two columns interleave when the PDF text is extracted, so a parsed quote would not be the sentence the report printed. Not parsed; left for a reading pass.
One bullet per province under "Prise en charge holistique" / "Continuite des soins": admissions, exits, patients hospitalised, beds and an occupancy rate, written as sentences.
